# C2N Importer Documentation

Welcome to the C2N Importer documentation!

## Quick Links

- [Dashboard Example](dashboard_example.md) - Interactive dashboard with metrics
- [API Reference](api/modules.rst) - Complete API documentation
- [Installation Guide](getting_started/installation.md) - How to install
- [Complex Tables Tutorial](tutorials/complex_tables.md) - Working with tables
- [Interactive Examples](tutorials/interactive_examples.ipynb) - Jupyter notebook examples

## Features

- **Smart Table Rendering** - Automatically converts complex tables to column layouts
- **Media Upload** - Upload images, videos, and documents to S3/CDN
- **Batch Processing** - Import entire Confluence spaces
- **Document Support** - PDFs, Word, Excel, and more

## Getting Started

1. Install C2N Importer
2. Configure your Notion token
3. Set up your upload strategy (S3, Cloudflare R2, or local tunnel)
4. Start importing!
